page.overview:
Who is Leroy Heming?

He is a former Piston Cup racer who competed in the 1950's of the Piston Cup Racing Series and he is Doc Hudson's Rival.

Leroy debuts in 1950's season at the Thomasville Speedway. He tried slam into a wall against the Fabulous Hudson Hornet. But Doc flapped over him, much to his surprise, and managed to win the race.

In 1954 he participated at the race at the Fireball Beach during which he was in 1st place until he got surpassed on the corner again by Doc. Unfortunately Doc lost the control and experienced a crash, which caused the race to come to a stop leaving everyone, including Leroy, in shock.

Leroy was rookie but a cold-hearted in his debut but he was angry when Doc tried to pass him and he slammed him into a wall.
